tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde ba can gyi zhing gi sgo 'byed smon lam bzhugs/na mo ār+ya sa man+ha bha dra ye/ bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lha/ /sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags/ /drang srong bden tshig grub rnams kyis/ /smon lam 'grub pa'i dpang bo mdzod/ /bdag ni skye zhing skye ba ru/ /ngan 'gror nam yang mi ltung zhing*/ /rtag tu dal 'byor tshang ba yi/ /lus rten khyad 'phags thob gyur cig /skyes ma thag nas srid 'byor la/ /ma chags nges 'byung bsam pa yis/ /rab byung thar ba don gnyer ba'i/ /rten bzang rnam dag rnyed gyur cig /gang du skyes kyang rigs gzugs 'byor/ /dbang phyug shes rab tshe ring zhing*/ /nad med bde ba mtho ris kyi/ /yon tan bdun dang ldan gyur cig /rtag tu dad dang thos pa dang*/ /khrel yod ngo tsha shes pa dang*/ /gtong dang tshul khrims blo gros kyi/ /'phags nor bdun dang ldan par shog /byams dang snying rje chen po yis/ /yid drangs byang chub sems bskyed de/ /phyin drug bsdu ba bzhi la sogs/ /rgyal sras spyod pa mthar phyin shog /bdag ni nam zhig 'chi 'pho'i tshe/ /'od dpag med mgon 'khor bcas kyi/ /zhal mthong tshur shog bde ldan du/ /'dong zhes gsung gis dbugs dbyung shog /de tshe ston pa 'khor bcas kyi/ /rdzu 'phrul mthu rje la brten nas/ /skar mda' 'phangs ltar thog med du/ /bde ba can du skye bar shog /zhing der pad+ma'i sbubs nyid du/ /brdzus te skyes nas de ma thag /myur thon rgyal ba 'khor bcas rnams/ /mthong nas chos nyan mchod par shog /dag pa'i zhing du skyes gyur nas/ /snying rjes ma dag zhing rnams su/ /bsam bzhin skye bzung 'gro 'dren par/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang ltar gyur cig /rgyal ba tshe dpag med nyid kyis/ /tshe rabs kun tu rjes 'dzin cing*/ /'chi med rig 'dzin stsol ba dang*/ /sgrib byang sangs rgyas nyid gyur cig /rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs dang*/ /rten 'brel mi bslu'i bden stobs kyis/

/ji ltar smon pa'i don thams cad/ /re ba bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /ces pa'i smon lam mdor bsdus 'di yang*/ blo bzang don grub kyi slar bskul ba ltar bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba ste/ 'di dang snga ma gnyis kyi par yig pa dang par du brko ba po yang bskul ba po nyid do/ /maṅga laṃ// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/bde ba can gyi zhing gi sgo 'byed smon lam bzhugs/ -PAGE 504--PAGE 95--PAGE 94-
